info.title: FinLover legacy API
info.description: Implemented operations only. GET lists, reports, wallets and current-user endpoints are not implemented. UI mock screens are not API integration.

post.description: Create a user with explicit privacy consent. confirmPassword must match password; password is limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Never returns passwordHash. Legacy response contract; auth is unified with v1. Cookie writes and login/register/logout require an exact trusted Origin; no Origin is rejected. A valid Bearer on protected APIs does not fall back to cookies.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: System category or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes
